name: Bunny Optimizer
description: Renders Drupal images through Bunny Optimizer (Bunny.net CDN image optimization).
project_description:
Features 
 This module integrates the Bunny Optimizer service as an image toolkit, allowing you to keep your existing image styles while offloading the generation and caching of image derivatives to Bunny CDN.

 Post-Installation 
 Change the image toolkit by going to Configuration > Media > Image toolkit , selecting Bunny Optimizer and filling in the CDN hostname setting.

 Image effects 
 The following standard image effects are supported by this image toolkit:

 
 Crop 
 Desaturate 
 Resize 
 Scale 
 Scale and crop 
 
 Other image effects should either be removed or be replaced by any of the custom image effects provided by this module:

 
 Automatically optimize 
 Blur 
 Brightness 
 Contrast 
 Flip vertically 
 Flip horizontally 
 Hue 
 Quality 
 Saturation 
 Sepia 
 Sharpen 
 Smart Face Crop 
 
 Image classes 
 Bunny Optimizer image classes can be applied by creating an image style with only the Apply a Bunny Optimizer image class image effect. More information about this feature can be found here .

 Additional Requirements 
 In addition to this module you need a Bunny CDN account with a pull zone configured to either pull images from an origin server or a Bunny storage zone.

 Recommended modules/libraries 
 The Bunny CDN module can be used if your pull zone is configured to cache full page responses.
